name: Spline Tube to Cylinder Mapping
definition: A technique to map a point from an arbitrary spline tube to a canonical vertical cylinder of radius 1 and height 1, allowing the use of a pre-defined density field defined on the cylinder.
summary: Spline Tube to Cylinder Mapping transforms points from a deformed tube into a canonical cylinder using the Frenet frame, enabling direct querying of isotropic density fields without storing or transforming the field itself.
